content_brand_colors_text: Night and Bone are the base; Flare is the one accent. The status colours are for meaning, not decoration.
content_brand_description: Download the SOTF Mods logo, isotype and colours, and see how to link to the site from your mod, video or server.
content_brand_do_contrast: Use the Night files on dark backgrounds and the Day files on light ones.
content_brand_do_size: Keep the full isotype at 24 px or larger (16 px for the simplified one).
content_brand_do_space: Leave clear space around the logo of at least a quarter of its height.

content_brand_font_display: Display: titles and figures, always in capitals.
content_brand_lead: Linking to SOTF Mods from your mod page, video or server? Use these files and keep the rules below.
content_brand_legal_text: The SOTF Mods name and logo identify this community site. You may use them to refer to or link to the site; any other use needs our permission.
content_brand_link_text: Copy this snippet into your README, website or mod description. It points to the live logo, so it always stays up to date.
content_brand_logos_text: Each asset comes in a Night version for dark backgrounds and a Day version for light ones. Prefer SVG; use PNG where SVG is not accepted.
content_dev_endpoints_text: Anonymous, cacheable and CORS-enabled. The reference documents parameters, responses and errors for each one.
content_dev_errors_text: The code field of an error is one of these. Each problem’s type URI points to its row here.
content_dev_legacy_deprecated_text: These routes keep answering until {date}, then they will be retired. Their responses carry these headers:
content_dev_legacy_deviations: Intentional differences from the old behaviour
content_dev_legacy_retired_text: Every method on these routes answers 410 Gone with this body:
content_dev_legacy_text: The API of the first version of the site still answers on api.sotf-mods.com/api/* and sotf-mods.com/api/*, so RedManager, UpdatesChecker and in-game mods keep working. New integrations should use v2.
content_dev_limits_text: Above a limit the API answers 429 with a Retry-After header. Cache responses and honour ETags; you will rarely come close.
content_dev_link_docs_text: Every v2 endpoint with schemas and examples, interactive.
content_dev_link_legacy_text: Still served; frozen routes sunset on {date}.
content_dev_link_openapi_text: The machine-readable spec, to generate a client.
content_draft_text: This text describes how SOTF Mods works today, but it has not been reviewed by a lawyer yet. It may change before it is final; we will date every change.

content_install_help_text: Check whether the current game patch broke your mods, or ask the community. Include your game version, RedLoader version and the mods you use.
content_install_kit_text: A staff-picked set of mods that work well together. A good first load-out.
content_kelvin_credit: KelvinSeek is made and maintained by {author}; SOTF Mods only runs the API it talks to. Kelvin and Sons of the Forest belong to Endnight Games; this is a fan project.
content_kelvin_description: KelvinSeek lets you chat with Kelvin in Sons of the Forest and give him orders in plain words. How it works, its limits and what happens to your messages.
content_kelvin_dev_hint: Building something similar? The endpoint is part of the legacy API:
content_kelvin_history_text: It was previously known as Kelvin-GPT. The old version that asked for your own OpenAI key is retired: that route exposed the key in the address and now answers “Gone”.
content_kelvin_how_1: Install RedLoader and the KelvinSeek mod.
content_kelvin_how_2: In game, walk up to Kelvin and press E to open the notepad.
content_kelvin_how_3: Press T to type, write your message and press Enter.
content_kelvin_how_4: Or use the console: “askkelvin …” sends a message, “clearkelvinchathistory” starts a fresh conversation.
content_kelvin_install_hint: New to mods? Start with the guide:
content_kelvin_lead: Write to Kelvin in plain words and he answers — and does what you ask, from fetching logs to building a shelter.
content_kelvin_limits_budget: The AI service has a daily budget. When it runs out, Kelvin still understands you: he picks the closest known order without AI until the next day.
content_kelvin_limits_busy: If you write too fast, Kelvin asks for a break for a few seconds. Nothing is lost.

match: Up to {perMinute__number} messages a minute and {perDay__number} a day per player.

content_kelvin_privacy_ai: The text of your messages is sent to the AI provider to generate the answer. Don’t write personal information.
content_kelvin_privacy_hash: The chat id sent by the mod (it contains your Steam id and name) is stored only as an irreversible hash.

profile_achievements_badges_intro: Badges fill each survivor’s field notebook. Locked ones show as dashed outlines with a hint, so you always know what’s next.
profile_achievements_day_body: Every profile shows how many days have passed since the account was created. Pure identity: it gives no points.
profile_achievements_fair_play_downloads: Downloads never give XP, so there’s nothing to gain from inflating them.
profile_achievements_fair_play_new_accou: Brand-new accounts weigh half in ratings and compatibility until they build trust.
profile_achievements_fair_play_reversibl: Every XP point is recorded and can be reversed if it came from abuse.
profile_achievements_fair_play_same_netw: Votes and reports between accounts on the same network within 24 hours don’t count.
profile_achievements_fair_play_spikes: Sudden download spikes are reviewed by the Rangers.
profile_achievements_intro: Every rule of the island’s rewards, in the open. They recognise quality and help, never raw volume.
profile_achievements_meta_description: How Survivor ranks, XP, creator tiers, badges and mod milestones work on SOTF Mods. Public rules that reward quality and help, not volume.
profile_achievements_milestones_intro: Every mod celebrates its download milestones, counted back to its first day. They appear as a timeline on the mod page and the biggest ones are announced on Discord.
profile_achievements_motw_body: Every Monday the mod with the strongest momentum among unique downloads wins, as long as it’s published, not broken on the current build and well rated. The same creator can’t win twice in a row within two weeks.
profile_achievements_principle_no_streak: No daily streaks, no loot boxes and no leaderboards that shame anyone.
profile_achievements_principle_privacy: You can hide your rank and activity in your privacy settings.
profile_achievements_principle_quality: XP comes from helping others: useful reviews, accurate field reports and solved problems. Downloads never give XP.
profile_achievements_principle_retroacti: Everything is retroactive: accounts from 2023 onwards keep what they already earned.
profile_achievements_ranks_intro: Every member has a Survivor rank that grows with the XP earned by helping the community. It can’t be bought and it’s never lost for inactivity.
profile_achievements_tier_perks_spotligh: Tier stamp, avatar frame and a spotlight on the home page.
profile_achievements_tiers_intro: Creators climb tiers automatically with the lifetime downloads of all their mods, history before v2 included. Each tier adds a stamp to the profile and a frame to the avatar.
profile_achievements_xp_note: Actions on your own content don’t count. XP is audited and can be reversed if it came from abuse.

social_compat_prompt: You downloaded v{version}. Did it work on {build}?
social_compat_result_broken_hint: It doesn’t load or it crashes.
social_compat_result_partial_hint: It loads, but something is broken.
social_compat_text: A field report takes ten seconds and tells everyone whether this mod works on the current patch.
social_compat_thanks: Thanks, survivor! Your field report counts toward the compatibility badge.
social_image_failed: The image couldn’t be uploaded. Remove it and try again.
social_image_size: Images can be up to 5 MB.
social_image_type: Use a PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF or GIF image.
social_image_wait: Wait until the images finish uploading.
social_offline: You’re offline. What you see may be out of date.
social_pin_limit: You can pin up to 3 comments. Unpin one first.
social_replies_failed: Couldn’t load the replies. Try again.
social_report_duplicate: You already reported this mod. The rangers have it.
social_report_intro: Rangers review every report. Tell them what’s wrong.
social_report_sent: Thanks. The rangers will take a look.
social_review_body_placeholder: What worked, what didn’t, and who is it for?
social_review_conflict: You already reviewed this mod. Edit your review instead.
social_review_forbidden: You can’t review this mod yet: reviews need a verified e-mail and an account at least 24 hours old, and creators can’t review their own mods.
social_review_own_mod: This is your mod: you can reply to each review once.
social_review_rules: One review per survivor. Be specific: version, what worked, what didn’t.
social_review_title_too_long: The title can have up to {max} characters.
social_verify_to_report: Verify your e-mail to send field reports.
social_verify_to_review: Verify your e-mail to write a review.
